Text.description: Nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

TrialSource.description: Independent trial providers; results are never folded or used as fallbacks.

description: Retrieve exact trial cards and bounded source sections in input order.

input.description: One to twenty exact NCT identifiers, in caller order.

limit.description: Record count per outcomes or arms page; eligibility pages follow the text budget.

offset.description: Character offset for eligibility or whole-record offset for outcomes and arms.

pool.description: Checked stored source record, supplied by a continuation.

section.description: Optional intact source sections. The default returns cards only.

source.description: Explicit provider; defaults to ClinicalTrials.gov and never falls back.

title: TrialGet
